func pinnedFile(t *testing.T, parent object, pathKey, hashKey, path string, raw []byte, mode os.FileMode) {
	t.Helper()
	script.Write(t, path, raw, mode)
	parent[pathKey] = path
	if hashKey != "" {
		parent[hashKey] = digest(raw)
	}
}
func fullyPinnedAllocationManifest(t *testing.T) object {
	t.Helper()
	manifest := exampleManifest(t)
	root := t.TempDir()
	auth := field(manifest, "authorization")
	auth["live_stress_authorized"] = true
	pinnedFile(t, auth, "owner_handoff_path", "owner_handoff_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "owner-handoff.json"), []byte("owner-authorized qualification handoff\n"), 0600)
	adapterPath, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	adapterHash := digest(script.Read(t, adapterPath))
	contract := field(manifest, "adapter_contract")
	contract["id"] = "frozen-alpha-d15-test"
	contract["frozen"] = true
	contract["source_path"] = adapterPath
	contract["source_sha256"] = adapterHash
	adapter := field(manifest, "adapter")
	adapter["executable_path"] = adapterPath
	adapter["executable_sha256"] = adapterHash
	for _, key := range []string{"memory_floor_evidence", "controller_memory_floor_evidence"} {
		for scope, e := range field(manifest, key) {
			pinnedFile(t, e.(map[string]any), "source_path", "source_sha256", filepath.Join(root, key+"-"+scope+".json"), jsonWire(t, object{"scope": scope, "basis": "allocation"}), 0600)
		}
	}
	transport := field(manifest, "transport")
	operator := field(transport, "operator")
	pinnedFile(t, operator, "executable_path", "executable_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "operator"), []byte("fixture operator\n"), 0700)
	pinnedFile(t, operator, "config_path", "config_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "operator.toml"), []byte("[fixture]\n"), 0600)
	ssh := field(transport, "ssh")
	pinnedFile(t, ssh, "executable_path", "executable_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "ssh"), []byte("fixture ssh\n"), 0700)
	for label, v := range field(ssh, "targets") {
		target := v.(map[string]any)
		pinnedFile(t, target, "known_hosts_path", "known_hosts_sha256", filepath.Join(root, label+"-known-hosts"), []byte("fixture host key\n"), 0600)
		pinnedFile(t, target, "identity_file_path", "", filepath.Join(root, label+"-key"), []byte("fixture private key\n"), 0600)
	}
	https := field(transport, "https")
	pinnedFile(t, https, "ca_bundle_path", "ca_bundle_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "client-ca.pem"), []byte("fixture CA bundle\n"), 0600)
	for _, label := range []string{"source", "peer"} {
		pinnedFile(t, https, label+"_credential_file", "", filepath.Join(root, label+"-token"), []byte("fixture-token\n"), 0600)
	}
	runtime := field(transport, "runtime")
	runtime["stress_launcher_sha256"] = adapterHash
	qualifier := script.Read(t, adapterPath)
	runtime["qualify_sha256"] = digest(qualifier)
	runtime["qualify_path"] = fmt.Sprintf("/run/terrascale-d15/probes/%s/%s/qualify", manifest["repository_revision"], digest(qualifier))
	runtime["remote_executable_path"] = runtime["qualify_path"]
	receipt := object{"schema": "terrascale.d15.probe-admission/v1", "repository": "TerraScale/ts-orchestrator", "source_revision": manifest["repository_revision"], "source_tree": strings.Repeat("a", 40), "release_tag": fmt.Sprintf("ci-%s-run-1", manifest["repository_revision"]), "run_id": 1, "run_number": 1, "workflow": "ci.yml", "job": producerJob, "job_id": 1, "attempt": 1, "probe_asset": probeAsset, "probe_bytes": len(qualifier), "probe_sha256": digest(qualifier), "publication_sha256": strings.Repeat("b", 64), "qualification_sha256": strings.Repeat("c", 64), "run_detail_sha256": strings.Repeat("d", 64), "job_log_sha256": strings.Repeat("e", 64)}
	pinnedFile(t, field(manifest, "probe_admission"), "receipt_path", "receipt_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "probe-admission.json"), jsonWire(t, receipt), 0600)
	field(field(manifest, "pressure"), "workload_cgroup")["io_device"] = "8:1"
	return manifest
}

memory.trace: newMemorySample creates synthetic raw counters, inode and boot metadata. ValidateMemorySample compares schema, identity, raw/hash fields and bounds; ValidateQualifier mutates only Runner.State sample records. NewRunner self-executable read is incidental to these targets.

	t.Helper()
	manifest := exampleManifest(t)
	root := t.TempDir()
	auth := field(manifest, "authorization")
	auth["live_stress_authorized"] = true
	pinnedFile(t, auth, "owner_handoff_path", "owner_handoff_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "owner-handoff.json"), []byte("owner-authorized qualification handoff\n"), 0600)
	adapterPath, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	adapterHash := digest(script.Read(t, adapterPath))
	contract := field(manifest, "adapter_contract")
	contract["id"] = "frozen-alpha-d15-test"
	contract["frozen"] = true
	contract["source_path"] = adapterPath
	contract["source_sha256"] = adapterHash
	adapter := field(manifest, "adapter")
	adapter["executable_path"] = adapterPath
	adapter["executable_sha256"] = adapterHash
	for _, key := range []string{"memory_floor_evidence", "controller_memory_floor_evidence"} {
		for scope, e := range field(manifest, key) {
			pinnedFile(t, e.(map[string]any), "source_path", "source_sha256", filepath.Join(root, key+"-"+scope+".json"), jsonWire(t, object{"scope": scope, "basis": "allocation"}), 0600)
		}
	}
	transport := field(manifest, "transport")
	operator := field(transport, "operator")
	pinnedFile(t, operator, "executable_path", "executable_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "operator"), []byte("fixture operator\n"), 0700)
	pinnedFile(t, operator, "config_path", "config_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "operator.toml"), []byte("[fixture]\n"), 0600)
	ssh := field(transport, "ssh")
	pinnedFile(t, ssh, "executable_path", "executable_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "ssh"), []byte("fixture ssh\n"), 0700)
	for label, v := range field(ssh, "targets") {
		target := v.(map[string]any)
		pinnedFile(t, target, "known_hosts_path", "known_hosts_sha256", filepath.Join(root, label+"-known-hosts"), []byte("fixture host key\n"), 0600)
		pinnedFile(t, target, "identity_file_path", "", filepath.Join(root, label+"-key"), []byte("fixture private key\n"), 0600)
	}
	https := field(transport, "https")
	pinnedFile(t, https, "ca_bundle_path", "ca_bundle_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "client-ca.pem"), []byte("fixture CA bundle\n"), 0600)
	for _, label := range []string{"source", "peer"} {
		pinnedFile(t, https, label+"_credential_file", "", filepath.Join(root, label+"-token"), []byte("fixture-token\n"), 0600)
	}
	runtime := field(transport, "runtime")
	runtime["stress_launcher_sha256"] = adapterHash
	qualifier := script.Read(t, adapterPath)
	runtime["qualify_sha256"] = digest(qualifier)
	runtime["qualify_path"] = fmt.Sprintf("/run/terrascale-d15/probes/%s/%s/qualify", manifest["repository_revision"], digest(qualifier))
	runtime["remote_executable_path"] = runtime["qualify_path"]
	receipt := object{"schema": "terrascale.d15.probe-admission/v1", "repository": "TerraScale/ts-orchestrator", "source_revision": manifest["repository_revision"], "source_tree": strings.Repeat("a", 40), "release_tag": fmt.Sprintf("ci-%s-run-1", manifest["repository_revision"]), "run_id": 1, "run_number": 1, "workflow": "ci.yml", "job": producerJob, "job_id": 1, "attempt": 1, "probe_asset": probeAsset, "probe_bytes": len(qualifier), "probe_sha256": digest(qualifier), "publication_sha256": strings.Repeat("b", 64), "qualification_sha256": strings.Repeat("c", 64), "run_detail_sha256": strings.Repeat("d", 64), "job_log_sha256": strings.Repeat("e", 64)}
	pinnedFile(t, field(manifest, "probe_admission"), "receipt_path", "receipt_sha256", filepath.Join(root, "probe-admission.json"), jsonWire(t, receipt), 0600)
	field(field(manifest, "pressure"), "workload_cgroup")["io_device"] = "8:1"
	return manifest

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

repo=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)
cd "$repo"

for tool in gh jq sha256sum stat; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { echo "$tool is required" >&2; exit 1; }
done
[[ ${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-} =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo 'GitHub run ID is required' >&2; exit 1; }
[[ ${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER:-} =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo 'GitHub run number is required' >&2; exit 1; }
[[ ${GITHUB_SHA:-} =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo 'GitHub source SHA is required' >&2; exit 1; }
: "${GH_TOKEN:?GitHub Actions token is required}"
export GH_HOST=github.com
repository=TerraScale/ts-orchestrator
[[ $(git rev-parse HEAD) == "$GITHUB_SHA" ]] || { echo 'checked-out source differs from the run' >&2; exit 1; }

source_tree=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')
go_version=$(go env GOVERSION)
go_mod_sha256=$(sha256sum go.mod | awk '{print $1}')
go_sum_sha256=$(sha256sum go.sum | awk '{print $1}')
probe_name=terrascale-d15-qualify
probe_source=dist/terrascale-orchestrator-linux-arm64
probe_path="dist/$probe_name"
[[ -s $probe_source && ! -L $probe_source ]] || { echo 'D15 probe source is missing or unsafe' >&2; exit 1; }
cp -- "$probe_source" "$probe_path"
chmod 0644 "$probe_path"
cmp -- "$probe_source" "$probe_path"
probe_bytes=$(stat -c '%s' "$probe_path")
probe_sha256=$(sha256sum "$probe_path" | awk '{print $1}')
[[ $probe_bytes -gt 0 && $probe_bytes -le 536870912 ]] || { echo 'D15 probe exceeds its bound' >&2; exit 1; }
artifacts='[]'
for architecture in amd64 arm64; do
    name="terrascale-orchestrator-linux-${architecture}"
    path="dist/${name}"
    [[ -s $path ]] || { echo "missing artifact: $path" >&2; exit 1; }
    bytes=$(stat -c '%s' "$path")
    sha256=$(sha256sum "$path" | awk '{print $1}')
    artifacts=$(jq -cnS --argjson previous "$artifacts" --arg architecture "$architecture" \
        --arg name "$name" --argjson bytes "$bytes" --arg sha256 "$sha256" \
        '$previous + [{architecture:$architecture,name:$name,bytes:$bytes,sha256:$sha256}]')
done

jq -cnS \
    --arg schema 'terrascale.d15.probe-publication/v1' \
    --arg repository 'TerraScale/ts-orchestrator' \
    --arg source_revision "$GITHUB_SHA" --arg source_tree "$source_tree" \
    --argjson run_id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --argjson run_number "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" \
    --arg name "$probe_name" --argjson bytes "$probe_bytes" --arg sha256 "$probe_sha256" \
    '{schema:$schema,repository:$repository,source_revision:$source_revision,
      source_tree:$source_tree,
      verification:{workflow:"ci.yml",job:"verify/go + artifact/linux-amd64-arm64",
        run_id:$run_id,run_number:$run_number},
      probe:{name:$name,bytes:$bytes,sha256:$sha256}}' \
    > dist/terrascale-d15-probe.json

jq -cnS \
    --arg schema 'terrascale.release.qualification.v1' \
    --arg repository 'TerraScale/ts-orchestrator' \
    --arg source_revision "$GITHUB_SHA" --arg source_tree "$source_tree" \
    --arg go_version "$go_version" --arg go_mod_sha256 "$go_mod_sha256" \
    --arg go_sum_sha256 "$go_sum_sha256" \
    --argjson run_id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --argjson run_number "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" \
    --argjson artifacts "$artifacts" \
    '{schema:$schema,repository:$repository,source_revision:$source_revision,
      source_tree:$source_tree,go_version:$go_version,go_mod_sha256:$go_mod_sha256,
      go_sum_sha256:$go_sum_sha256,
      verification:{workflow:"ci.yml",job:"verify/go + artifact/linux-amd64-arm64",
        run_id:$run_id,run_number:$run_number,conclusion:"success"},artifacts:$artifacts}' \
    > dist/qualification.json

umask 077
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'find "$work" -depth -delete' EXIT

tag="ci-${GITHUB_SHA}-run-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
if ! gh release view "$tag" --repo "$repository" --json tagName,isDraft,isPrerelease,assets > "$work/view.json" 2>/dev/null; then
    gh release create "$tag" --repo "$repository" --target "$GITHUB_SHA" --prerelease \
        --title "$tag" --notes ''
    gh release view "$tag" --repo "$repository" --json tagName,isDraft,isPrerelease,assets > "$work/view.json"
fi
jq -e --arg tag "$tag" '.tagName == $tag and .isDraft == false and .isPrerelease == true and
    (.assets | all(.name == "terrascale-orchestrator-linux-amd64" or
      .name == "terrascale-orchestrator-linux-arm64" or .name == "terrascale-d15-qualify" or
      .name == "terrascale-d15-probe.json" or .name == "qualification.json" or
      (.name | test("^production-[A-Z]{3}-(amd64|arm64)(-delegation)?\\.json$")) or
      (.name | test("^production-evidence-[0-9a-f]{64}$")) or
      (.name | test("^image-production-[0-9a-f]{64}-[A-Z]{3}-(amd64|arm64)(-delegation)?\\.json$")) or
      (.name | test("^image-production-evidence-[0-9a-f]{64}$"))))' "$work/view.json" >/dev/null || {
    echo 'retained release has an unexpected tag, state or asset' >&2; exit 1;
}
[[ $(gh api "repos/$repository/commits/$tag" --jq .sha) == "$GITHUB_SHA" ]] || {
    echo 'retained release tag points to a different source revision' >&2; exit 1;
}
mkdir -m 0700 "$work/readback"
retain() {
    local name=$1 delay matched attempt readback
    if ! jq -e --arg name "$name" 'any(.assets[]; .name == $name)' "$work/view.json" >/dev/null; then
        gh release upload "$tag" "dist/$name" --repo "$repository"
    fi
    delay=1
    matched=false
    for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
        readback="$work/readback/$name.$attempt"
        if gh release download "$tag" --repo "$repository" --pattern "$name" --output "$readback" &&
            cmp -- "dist/$name" "$readback"; then
            matched=true
            break
        fi
        if [[ -f $readback ]]; then
            printf 'D15 release asset readback mismatch name=%s attempt=%s bytes=%s sha256=%s\n' \
                "$name" "$attempt" "$(stat -c '%s' "$readback")" \
                "$(sha256sum "$readback" | awk '{print $1}')" >&2
        fi
        if [[ $attempt == 6 ]]; then
            break
        fi
        sleep "$delay"
        delay=$((delay * 2))
    done
    [[ $matched == true ]] || { echo "D15 release asset readback never matched: $name" >&2; exit 1; }
}
retain terrascale-orchestrator-linux-amd64
retain terrascale-orchestrator-linux-arm64
retain "$probe_name"
retain terrascale-d15-probe.json
# The manifest is the completion marker. A partial upload cannot be admitted.
retain qualification.json
printf 'TS_D15_PROBE_PUBLICATION_V1 source_sha=%s run_id=%s run_number=%s probe_sha256=%s descriptor_sha256=%s\n' \
    "$GITHUB_SHA" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" "$probe_sha256" \
    "$(sha256sum dist/terrascale-d15-probe.json | awk '{print $1}')"
printf 'TS_RELEASE_QUALIFICATION_V1 source_sha=%s run_id=%s run_number=%s manifest_sha256=%s\n' \
    "$GITHUB_SHA" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" \
    "$(sha256sum dist/qualification.json | awk '{print $1}')"

        annotations:
          summary: '{{ $labels.service }} availability error budget is burning'
          description: 'Burn exceeds 6x in both 6h and 30m; inspect service failures before changing capacity or releases.'
      - alert: ServiceSLOBurnDaily
        expr: (slo:burn_rate:ratio1d > 3) and on (service, slo) (slo:burn_rate:ratio2h > 3)
        labels:
          severity: warning
          long_window: 1d
          short_window: 2h
        annotations:
          summary: '{{ $labels.service }} availability error budget is burning'
          description: 'Burn exceeds 3x in both 1d and 2h; inspect service failures before changing capacity or releases.'
      - alert: ServiceSLOBurnSteady
        expr: (slo:burn_rate:ratio3d > 1) and on (service, slo) (slo:burn_rate:ratio6h > 1)
        labels:
          severity: warning
          long_window: 3d
          short_window: 6h
        annotations:
          summary: '{{ $labels.service }} availability error budget is burning'
          description: 'Burn exceeds 1x in both 3d and 6h; inspect service failures before changing capacity or releases.'
      - alert: ServiceSLOTelemetryMissing
        expr: |
          (slo:objective unless on (service) sum by (service) (count_over_time(terrascale_slo_requests_total{outcome="good"}[5m])))
          or
          (slo:objective unless on (service) sum by (service) (count_over_time(terrascale_slo_requests_total{outcome="bad"}[5m])))
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: '{{ $labels.service }} SLO telemetry is missing'
          description: 'No recent good or bad request counter; restore instrumentation or collection. Missing telemetry is not availability success.'

qualification_limits: SOURCE_ONLY_CANDIDATE; runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION. No tests/builds/project helpers/runtime probes/cloud/signing/crypto/TerraBase executed. Metadata hashing only.

No OCI, SSH, real pressure worker, kernel OOM, SIGKILL, running service, GitHub publication or admitted production probe qualification. Cgroup fixtures are ordinary filesystem directories; Witness and Signal are injected.

TestPrometheusRules skips if TS_SLO_PROMTOOL is empty, and source does not pin the external executable identity. Category describes the configured process path; no tool availability or actual evaluation outcome is claimed.

TestRemotePinnedProbe passes os.Getuid as expected owner and also expects GID equal that UID in production. Temp-file group ownership/OS support are runtime assumptions, unverified here. Kernel openat2, file mode and identity semantics require a compatible Linux environment.

Publisher uses real subprocess and filesystem boundaries with fake gh/git/go/sleep; checked attachment bytes are fixture bytes, not compiled CI artifacts. Admission receipt sources are synthetic local files, not live CI or release trust receipts.

All safety, validation, negative, retry, byte-preservation, authority and recovery obligations retained. No source retirement, ledger/category count promotion, deletion, runtime qualification or global completion credit. Distinct peer review required.
